_original_lore: The Powder Ghast is a mob that spawns,
randomly in Dwarven Mines. It's not a part of the regular cycle,
and instead is a random occurrence. The Powder Ghast can spawn
in one of the following locations: Divan's Gateway,
Rampart's Quarry, Cliffside Veinsand Forge Basin.
The Powder Ghast is immune to melee damage. Players will receive,
60 Mithril Powder for every hit that lands on its hitbox.
name: 火药恶魂 (怪物)
